_why: Skill-candidates row 'a data fixture floods the delta self-review': `--rev 4fd01b3` reported claims=19, all from a 152-line JSONL fixture the commit added. A new file whose every added line is a JSON object or array is now skipped and named (19 -> 2 on that commit). These rows prove each scope limit has a test that bites.

mutations.name: data-files-are-reviewed-again
mutations._mechanism: The flood returns: every quoted command in a corpus is reported as the revision's claim.
mutations.find: return new and bool(rows) and all(_is_json_row(l) for l in rows)

mutations.name: one-json-row-makes-a-data-file
mutations._mechanism: A file with prose claims beside its rows is skipped whole, hiding the prose.
mutations.find: return new and bool(rows) and all(_is_json_row(l) for l in rows)
mutations.replace: return new and bool(rows) and any(_is_json_row(l) for l in rows)

mutations.name: existing-corpora-are-skipped-too
mutations._mechanism: Rows appended to a file that already existed are skipped, widening past the row's scope.
mutations.find: return new and bool(rows) and all(_is_json_row(l) for l in rows)
mutations.replace: return bool(rows) and all(_is_json_row(l) for l in rows)

mutations.name: any-json-value-is-a-row
mutations._mechanism: A line that is a bare JSON string counts as a record, so a file of quoted prose is skipped as a corpus.
